permissionGrantId.$comment: Direct Records and Protocols operations invoke a single grant with permissionGrantId. Message.createSignature rejects payloads that also include permissionGrantIds.

permissionGrantIds.$comment: Messages operations invoke grants with permissionGrantIds, including the single-grant case. Message.createSignature rejects payloads that also include permissionGrantId.

protocolRole.$comment: Used in the Records interface to authorize role-authorized actions for protocol records
